how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-15-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4785:completion:0: Here you go, ⟦1⟧. And please tell Menara we say hello.⟦2⟧⟦3⟧We expect great things of you. Perhaps when the Legion falls to its knees, your name will be spoken aloud and in praise of your power. I can't wait!
rows.quest:92432:title: An Alarming Request
rows.quest:92432:obj:0: Report to the ⟦E7⟧ near the City of ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:92432:details:0: I bring ill tidings from ⟦E8⟧. Something has disrupted our ley lines, causing erratic and destructive behavior from our constructs in the city.
rows.quest:92432:details:1: We know not yet what is causing this mayhem. The high council has ordered us to keep this matter private so as to not bring shame to our order. But we cannot keep up this charade forever. The city is being overrun as we speak!
rows.quest:92432:details:2: Archmage Modera has dispatched me to solicit outside aid. Seek her image out near ⟦E8⟧ beside Lordamere Lake.
rows.quest:92456:title: A Green Sample
rows.quest:92456:obj:0: Collect a ⟦E9⟧ from the City of ⟦E8⟧ for ⟦E10⟧ in ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:92456:details:0: If you're going to bother me you can at least make yourself useful. I have an errand I need run.
rows.quest:92456:details:1: For a city of mages, ⟦E8⟧ has a surprising interest in botany. The Kirin ⟦E12⟧ keep to themselves, but I would love a sample of their mana-infused vegetation.
rows.quest:92456:details:2: You're clearly someone who is comfortable being where people don't want you, maybe you could find a way into the city. If you do, bring me back whatever is growing in their central garden.
rows.quest:8879:title: Large Rockets
rows.quest:8879:progress:0: Large Festival rockets light up the sky brilliantly - only the cluster rockets rival their magnificence!⟦4⟧⟦5⟧Bring me coins of ancestry, ⟦6⟧, and I shall share the knowledge of their creation.
rows.quest:8879:completion:0: Very well - I accept these coins of ancestry. Here are your recipes, ⟦7⟧. May you use them to spread ⟦E13⟧'s glory!
